title: Influence of Reaction Conditions and Promoting Role of Ammonia Produced at Higher Temperature Conditions in Its Synthesis Process over Cs-Ru/MgO Catalyst
extraction_notes: No SI plotted performance records were extracted. SI Figure S1 (page 3) is a set of small 3D surface plots of STY versus H2/N2 ratio and pressure at multiple temperatures and space velocities; the underlying grid values are not shown as discrete markers and many surface regions are occluded/too small to digitise reliably from the provided raster. SI Figures S2 and S3 are captioned as applications of a rate equation to experimental data; these are model/rate-equation comparison plots rather than direct catalytic-performance versus operating-condition plots, and the corresponding images were not provided here for reliable point extraction.
